tests.description: Verifies enemy HP scaling: base 2/2, then 3/3 for both surviving and newly spawned enemies after the 15s tick.
tests.name: Enemy HP scales with time
source: const keepAway = () => { const p = harness.getObjects('Player')[0]; if (p) harness.setObjectPosition(e.id, p.x + 2000, p.y + 1200); };

harness.assert(st.behaviors.Health.state.Health === 2 && st.behaviors.Health.state.MaxHealth === 2, 'Enemy starts at 2/2 HP before the first scaling tick (got ' + st.behaviors.Health.state.Health + '/' + st.behaviors.Health.state.MaxHealth + ')');
harness.assert(!!st, 'the enemy survived past the 15s scaling tick');
harness.assert(!!st && st.behaviors.Health.state.MaxHealth === 3, 'Enemy max health scaled to 3 after 15s (got ' + (st ? st.behaviors.Health.state.MaxHealth : 'n/a') + ')');
harness.assert(!!st && st.behaviors.Health.state.Health === 3, 'Enemy current health also scaled to 3 (got ' + (st ? st.behaviors.Health.state.Health : 'n/a') + ')');

harness.assert(o2.behaviors.Health.state.MaxHealth === 3 && o2.behaviors.Health.state.Health === 3, 'A freshly spawned enemy after 15s also starts at 3/3 HP (got ' + o2.behaviors.Health.state.Health + '/' + o2.behaviors.Health.state.MaxHealth + ')');
